summary.name: Cleaner
summary.one_liner: Open-source (MIT) macOS cleaner that shows every item and its rule before removal, and moves removed items to a 7-day quarantine you can restore from.
use_cases: Free up disk space on a Mac by reviewing cache and log items before removal
Uninstall Mac apps along with leftover Library files and Dock icons
Find which folders take the most space on a Mac
Disable or enable login agents and daemons without deleting them
Monitor CPU, memory, network, disk and battery from the menu bar
Restore accidentally removed cleanup items within 7 days
summary.what_it_does: The app scans the Mac (read-only) and lists reclaimable items such as app caches, logs, the Trash, old installers in Downloads, Xcode builds, and package caches for npm, Bun, pnpm, Gradle and Cargo. Each item shows its folder, size and the rule that found it; the user unchecks anything to keep, and removal requires holding the button for 3 seconds. Removed items go to a quarantine folder for 7 days and can be restored one at a time or as a whole batch. It also lists apps with size and last use and removes their leftovers, toggles LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons, shows folder sizes, and includes a menu bar monitor for CPU, memory, network, GPU, disk and battery. The page says it does not touch duplicate files, cloud storage, or include antimalware.
notable: Shows every item and the rule behind it before anything is removed; removal goes to a 7-day quarantine with one-click restore
Cleaning rules are in one public rules.json file, and the whole app is open source under MIT
Menu bar monitor for CPU, memory, network, disk, battery and GPU, with a button to free cached memory
Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple; installs via a one-line curl command
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 14 or newer; Intel Macs are not supported yet
Full scan needs Full Disk Access and system items need the administrator password; without Full Disk Access it shows less
Does not find duplicate files or similar photos, does not clean cloud storage, and has no antimalware
